answer_1.quote: The goal of learning generative models of events is to learn a distribution p(G) over TKGs, based on a set of observed event sets {G 1, ..., G t}.
answer_1.outputs: Generated temporal knowledge graphs (sequences of events over time) in the form of (subject, relation, object, time) quadruples.
